title: NY State Senate · District 12
area: Western and Northwestern Queens, including Astoria, Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Jackson Heights and parts of Elmhurst.

context.text: This is an open seat: incumbent Michael Gianaris did not file for re-election to the Senate. Aber Kawas defeated Assemblymember Steven Raga 60.2%–39.4% in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary to become the Democratic and Working Families Party nominee; Han Khon To advanced from the Republican primary without appearing on the ballot.

priorities.text: Supports establishing a New York State Social Housing Development Authority as her primary legislative vehicle for building more low- and moderate-income housing statewide.
Campaigns on affordable housing, universal healthcare, immigration reform, expanded public transit and climate action.
Campaign platform names "Fund Dignity" priorities of healthcare for all, fast and reliable transit, and affordable housing.
Campaign platform names "Fight Destruction" priorities of stopping climate change, ending war funding, and protecting immigrants.
Supports raising taxes on the wealthy to fund state programs, describing this as central to her legislative agenda.

positions.summary: Supports creating a New York State Social Housing Development Authority to build more low- and moderate-income housing.
Campaigns on universal healthcare as a core priority.
Campaigns on protecting immigrants and immigration reform, drawing on her own family's experience with ICE detention and deportation.
Lists stopping climate change among her campaign's core priorities.
Supports taxing the wealthy as part of her campaign platform.
Co-developed a campaign opposing nonprofit funding of Israeli military operations and campaigns on ending war funding.

priorities.text: Opposes relying solely on solar energy for power and supports continued availability of gas stations, saying at a candidate forum: "I will issue more licenses for gas stations, and we need more power than to only depend on solar systems in your house or in the car. I want to maintain the balance."
priorities.quote: I will issue more licenses for gas stations, and we need more power than to only depend on solar systems in your house or in the car. I want to maintain the balance.

priorities.text: Supports increased funding for law enforcement and deportation of undocumented immigrants, according to campaign materials distributed at a 2024 candidate forum.

positions.summary: Opposes a transition that relies solely on solar energy, favoring continued reliance on gas-powered energy alongside it.

positions.summary: Supports deportation of undocumented immigrants, per campaign materials distributed at a 2024 forum.
Supports increased funding for law enforcement, per campaign materials distributed at a 2024 forum.
